dedupe_keys.name: the global urban building height to building side length and roof albedo data for urban modeling

description: The dataset authors publish global urban morphology and roof-albedo parameters for land-surface and urban-canopy models. Zenodo supplies three compressed archives under CC BY 4.0. NetCDF tiles contain the ratio of building height to side length and roof albedo. Two morphology estimates combine different building datasets; two albedo estimates use local-climate-zone or NCAR urban classes. These parameters can drive urban heat, radiative-transfer and building-energy simulations where coarse morphology is sufficient. Related catalogue data-3d-globfp-global-3d-building-footprints is one upstream footprint source named by the provider, not the same derived parameter set. Coverage is global urban areas represented in five-degree tiles, not measured roof reflectance of individual buildings. A limitation is that ratios inherit biases from each input building map and albedo values depend on class assumptions. No archive was downloaded, and coordinate conventions or tile completeness were not checked.
